Cookie.effect: Opposed rating × 2 vs. target Firewall + Stealth. Logs the icon's nodes, who it talked to and when (not contents), programs. Net hits set depth (1 = outline, 4+ = detailed). Ends at a preset time and reports back. Detect: Matrix Perception (4); remove: Computer + Edit (2).

Diagnostics.effect: Teamwork Test, sprite rating × 2; each hit +1 die to a character using/repairing the device, up to the character's skill.

Electron Storm.effect: On a successful cybercombat hit, engulfs the target: rating DV Matrix damage, AP –2 each of the sprite's phases; target –2 on all Matrix actions. Escape: Complex Action, Opposed Response × 2 vs. the sprite.

Gremlins.effect: Opposed rating × 2 vs. device System + Firewall: device suffers a glitch; 4 net hits = critical glitch. Against drones/vehicles can force a Crash Test with the rating as a penalty.

Hash.effect: Temporarily encrypts a file so only the sprite can decrypt it; reverts if the sprite leaves; sprite destroyed = file permanently corrupted.

Steganography.effect: Hides data inside another file; invisible to searches; found only by Matrix Perception (4) (even by the sprite).

Stability.effect: Prevents normal malfunctions and glitches (also those from Gremlins/Accident) on a node/device/program/icon; critical glitches become standard glitches.

Suppression.effect: Any alert the sprite triggers is delayed rating ÷ 2 (round up) Combat Turns.

Watermark.effect: Invisible tag only Resonance beings can read; can be overwritten.

Assault.effect: two attacks as with two weapons; only Pilot is halved, each Attack CF added to one half (needs two Attack CFs). Once per combat against an icon.

Castling.effect: Complex Action; redirect damage aimed at the technomancer to itself by mimicking his access ID.

Hardening.effect: Armor CF behaves like hardened armor while used (Complex Action, like full defence).

Info Sortilege.effect: as the echo, with rating instead of Resonance.

Probability Distribution.effect: Rating×2 vs half node Response (round up); success adds/removes half rating (round up) dice on a target test; Complex Action, so the sprite must have delayed.

Proficiency.effect: tutor assists a non-skilled user in AR/VR: test without modifiers using half rating (round up) as skill; takes an Extended or Complex action.

Traceroute.effect: Extended Rating + Track, 1 hour base interval, threshold by how often the subject uses the Matrix: constantly 4, a few hours/day 8, once a day 12, less than daily 16. Modifiers: last transaction logged –1; subject using Stealth +Stealth; SIN/commcode/MSP address known –3. Success finds the subject's current node or last physical access point.

Blend.effect: -2 to Matrix Perception to spot it and -2 to attacks against it.

Credit.effect: Monthly Rating + Edge Test: each hit = 10,000 nuyen of permanent black-account cash carrying its signature; can also make daily counterfeit cash of rating = rating / 2 that vanishes after 8 hours.

Denial.effect: Treated as having tasks equal to its Edge (refreshing every 8 hours) for the purposes of decompiling. All free sprites have it.

Doorstop.effect: Rating + Response vs Willpower + Resonance; traps the user online while sustained; disconnecting from outside causes dumpshock.

Resonance Bond.effect: Quality-like bond (UW p.160): both parties act as resonance link / datatrail for each other. Examples: Allocation Bond (+half the sprite Resonance dice to Fading tests), Echo Bond (share one power/CF/echo/widget each way), Networking Bond (share one CF each way).

Resonance Rift.effect: Opens rifts to resonance realms (UW p.172).

Transfer.effect: Grants one of its powers to up to Rating subjects (one power per subject).

Datavore.effect: after a successful attack, every 3 damage = +1 rating temporarily (max half starting rating, round down) for Resonance Combat Turns.

Distortion.effect: Complex Action; all Matrix test dice pools in the node reduced by the sprite's rating while sustained (Simple Action per pass after the first); users can roll System + Response to reduce the penalty by 1 per hit. Against technomancers/sprites: Rating × 2 vs Resonance + Firewall; each Combat Turn sustained, –1 Resonance; at 0, physical dumpshock (DV increased by the sprite's power). Resonance returns at 1 per 10 minutes. One use per node.

Peak.effect: replaces damage with a tripchip-like BTL blast: penalty on all actions equal to net hits for Resonance Combat Turns; possible mental addiction test. Hot-sim VR only.

Resonance Drain.effect: after a hit, drains 1 Resonance per pass (Simple Action); at 0, dissonant dumpshock as above.

Siphon.effect: Same as the dissonant / technomancer echo of the same name (see echoes.json).

Surge.effect: Opposed Rating × 2 vs the device's System + Firewall (or Device rating × 2); each net hit = 1 box of damage to the device; sprite must be in a node linked to the device but not inside the device.

Virulence.effect: Rating × 2 vs program rating + Firewall; success infects the program with a GM-chosen virus.

Sparky.effect: Same as the dissonant / technomancer echo of the same name (see echoes.json).
